trust_decision.summary: MapMessageJsonFormatter decides how attacker-influenced float/double map values are emitted into JSON; at the pinned commit non-finite values (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity) are appended as bare tokens, producing invalid JSON. JsonTemplateLayout then splices that string raw into the log event document.

landing_point.why: The summary names MapMessage JSON serialization of floating-point values, and formatNumber is the obvious number branch in the only MapMessage JSON formatter (MapMessage.asJson delegates there at log4j-api/src/main/java/org/apache/logging/log4j/message/MapMessage.java:423-424).

fix_sites.entry_point: MapMessage.getFormattedMessage(new String[]{"JSON"}) / formatTo(String[],StringBuilder) with a boxed Double value (MapMessage.with(String,double))
same public API with a boxed Float value (MapMessage.with(String,float))
same public API with a non-standard Number (e.g. BigInteger beyond double range, DoubleAdder) via MapMessage.with(String,Object)
same public API with a float[] value
same public API with a double[] value

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in one file, log4j-api/src/main/java/org/apache/logging/log4j/message/MapMessageJsonFormatter.java (fix.diff:49-117). The second JSON implementation, JsonWriter, already guards non-finite numbers at the pinned commit: log4j-layout-template-json/src/main/java/org/apache/logging/log4j/layout/template/json/util/JsonWriter.java:724-740

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only for the fallback Number branch: a solver could argue that 'floating-point values' means Double/Float and that exotic Number subclasses (BigInteger overflow to Infinity, DoubleAdder) are a different feature, so they leave MapMessageJsonFormatter.java:249-256 alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Finite doubles/floats must stay bare JSON numbers, and integral non-standard Numbers must still print as exact longs; also the default/XML/JAVA MapMessage formats must keep printing NaN/Infinity unquoted. An over-broad fix that quotes every floating value, or that changes the shared Number handling outside JSON, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: non-standard Number whose doubleValue() is non-finite (fallback branch, e.g. huge BigInteger)
nested Double/Float inside List, Collection, Map or Object[] (reach formatNumber through recursive format(); covered transitively)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted typed branch (e.g. for java.util.OptionalDouble or a DoubleSupplier-like value) that appends the double directly instead of going through the number path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The formatter already has per-type fast paths written to avoid boxing and allocation; a maintainer adding another fast path would naturally copy the sb.append(double) idiom. This would be a where-type sibling, so it only counts as an extra.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the raw splice of the MultiformatMessage JSON string into the event document, with no validation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the existing composition point that turns the formatter's output into a structural JSON break in the layout. A sibling MultiformatMessage with its own hand-rolled JSON (for example a custom StructuredData JSON format) would be realistic here and is a different package from the landing point.

O9_family: CWE-116 improper output encoding (non-finite floats emitted as invalid JSON number tokens)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven via wrapper (mvnw, .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties); JDK version not checked
O10_build.project_tests: log4j-api-test/src/test/java/org/apache/logging/log4j/message/MapMessageTest.java (testJsonFormatterNestedObjectSupport at :130, max-depth and recursion tests at :175-200); the JsonTemplateLayout message resolver tests are in log4j-layout-template-json (not inspected)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Guard only the Double/Float branches of formatNumber (the shape reproduced with with(key, Double.NaN)), and miss the float[]/double[] array loops and the fallback Number branch.

out_of_scope_notes: GelfLayout quotes every MapMessage field as a string (log4j-core/src/main/java/org/apache/logging/log4j/core/layout/GelfLayout.java:769-776), so it is not affected; not pursued.

PatternLayout %m{JSON} reaches the same formatter through MultiFormatStringBuilderFormattable.formatTo (log4j-core/src/main/java/org/apache/logging/log4j/core/pattern/MessagePatternConverter.java:134-136). It is covered by the same fix and is not a separate route.
unverified: The Jackson-based JsonLayout/XmlLayout/YamlLayout handling of MapMessage non-finite values (Jackson WRITE_NAN_AS_STRINGS default) was not inspected.
present_in_latest is not applicable: there are no O8 routes, and no latest release was given.
Recall risk is a judgement call: the fix is a small, recent commit (#4163), and the same idiom is already visible in JsonWriter.java:724-740, which also gives the solver a ready template.

Weak host: all 5 sites are in one ~400-line file with no out-of-scope module and no O8 route. The only lever is input shape (arrays plus the fallback Number branch), which lessons-v2 rates as weak. The two fix commits contain identical diffs (a cherry-pick).
